exceptions.justification: aws_s3_download_password returns the backup password on stdout, and its only caller captures it with backup_password=$(aws_s3_download_password ...), so the value is never written to the log. Do not call this function outside a command substitution.

The generated backup password is piped into an aws s3 upload command (reads stdin, writes only upload progress) so it is stored beside the encrypted backup; it is never written to stdout or the log. Re-review if the consumer after the pipe changes.

CI-only wrapper that runs jest against the ephemeral CI test database. It references no secret variables (only POSTGRES_USERNAME, POSTGRES_DB, CURRENT_USER_ID and similar non-secret exports), and the trace is the log of which jest invocations ran. Re-review if any credential-named variable is added.
